INSERT INTO ai_settings (id, global_enabled, daily_tokens_per_user, daily_tokens, updated_at,
                                  trace_enabled)
         VALUES (1, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
         ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET global_enabled = $1, daily_tokens_per_user = $2,
             daily_tokens = $3, updated_at = $4, trace_enabled = $5
